Contract:
A direct reconcile edit returns this exact evidence block:
``` DirectVerificationReceipt: target-set: [] command: npx gennady sdd-check --all exit: 0 output: ```
The target-set is frozen before editing and contains only canonical task-free SDD tracker/index metadata paths, or one canonical spec path proven editorial. `` is `specs/` for that editorial spec or `` for tracker/index metadata. The command is selected before editing and run exactly once after the edit. Missing output, nonzero exit, a changed target-set, an edit outside it, or an artifact without this dedicated verifier invalidates the direct path and routes to ticket recovery/creation instead.
